metadata.datasource: Characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities from Fujifilm AF3-967E, FUJICOLOR SUPERIA REALA [CS], CN-16, Status M. The curves were read from the vector plot, each layer by its order, and converted from Status M densities into dye amounts with the donor's dye spectra and the base density of the agx reference profile 'fujifilm_xtra_400'. Mid-grey where a meter set to EI 100 puts it on the sheet's absolute axis (log H -1.090 lux-seconds). Layer contrast about mid-grey scaled by R 0.922, G 0.965, B 1.093. The sheet's sensitivity shapes continue on the donor's tails beyond the plotted range and are balanced so an 18% grey exposes every layer equally. Dye spectra, base density, Hanatos-2025 adaptation parameters, DIR couplers inherited from 'fujifilm_xtra_400', which shares this stock's dye set and process.
